title: Ek nanhi si lahad
body:
Ek nanhi si lahad
Ek nanhi si lahad ran me banate hain HUSSAIN, Khaak me dusre MOHSIN ko chupate hain HUSSAIN.
<<MINI>>
Ek nanhi si..
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Dalte jate hai ASGHAR k badan par mitti-2 Or khaimo'n ki taraf dekhte jate hain HUSSAIN.
<<MINI>>
Ek nanhi si..
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Marte dum nanhe se hatho'n ne jise thama tha-2
Ab wo daaman ALI ASGHAR se chudate hain HUSSAIN.
<<MINI>>
Ek nanhi si..
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Lash e HUR ne kaha rumaal ye de do jakar-2
Zakhm besheer ka hatho'n se chupate hain HUSSAIN.
<<MINI>>
Ek nanhi si..
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Dhundhne aayenge is lashe ko naiza bardaar, Chup k bano se ye ZAINAB ko batate hain HUSSAIN.
5) Kaha SUGHRA ne k mar kar to milungi SHEH se-2
Mujhko maloom hai har qabr me aate hain HUSSAIN.
<<MINI>>
Ek nanhi si..
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Lash e ABBAS pe kehti thi ye. ZAHRA roke-2
Utho ABBAS tumhe kab se bulate hain HUSSAIN.
7) Koi ZAINAB ko bula laye Takallum Takallum jakar-2
Barchi AKBAR k kaleje se chudate hain HUSSAIN.
Ek nanhi si lahad ran me banate hain HUSSAIN.
